messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — orchid-v1 int8 bring-up finished. small surprise on news holdout: recall@10 drop vs fp16.
Liam: can you paste the eval numbers & config?
Maya: sure, short run (10k news/wikipedia holdouts):
Maya: ```
config: model=orchid-v1 quant=int8_perchannel batch=128 seq=128
wikipedia: r@1=0.734 r@5=0.874 r@10=0.906
news: r@1=0.608 r@5=0.753 r@10=0.853
``` 
Anya: fp16 baseline for news r@10 was 0.909 last week, so ~5.6% absolute drop. Did you keep L2 norm/length-scaling identical?
Maya: postproc identical. cluster silhouette on news fell 0.44 -> 0.29.
Liam: sounds like activation clipping on OOD tokens. Any activation ranges per-layer?
Maya: pulled logs:
Maya: ```
layer3_act_range_all: mean=2.0 std=0.8
layer3_act_range_news: mean=3.9 std=1.5
clipping_events: 134 / 10k
```
Anya: yep. plan: try symmetric int8 vs asymmetric, per-channel recalibration, and l2-before-matmul ablation. Also collect per-topic breakdown.
Maya: kicking off three ablations now. ops-bot: deploy orchid-int8-ablate -> succeeded on staging (2026-03-20_15:02)
Maya: update 40m: symmetric int8 -> news r@10=0.879; silhouette=0.34; centroid drift(fp16->quant)=0.09
Maya: per-channel recalib running, will post when done. adding per-topic (politics/sports/tech) to the harness.
Sara: good. add avg intra/inter-cluster cosine and centroid cosine drift to the eval outputs. we'll need a short runbook for Dedicated customers if we ship.
Liam: also try normalizing embeddings right before quantized matmul as a control.
Maya: noted. reproducible CLI:
Maya: ```bash
python eval_embeddings.py --model orchid-v1 --quant int8 --holdout news_holdout.json --metrics recall silhouette centroid_drift intra_inter_cosine
```
Maya: tagging eng-ml for visibility. will drop full per-topic table + recalib results shortly.
